verdict.rationale: Semgrep's docs describe a simple pattern-matching rule syntax with a live editor for writing/testing custom rules, and rules can be shared across repos via registry configs, CI integration, and centralized AppSec Platform deployment; community testimony corroborates security engineers writing custom rules for cross-codebase antipatterns and praises the readable, cross-language rule syntax. Missing for 10: no first-party documentation of a dedicated 'rule sharing/registry publishing' workflow beyond CI configs, and some community reports note ease of bypass/false positives affecting rule robustness.
